description: What this company and one of its projects could still set up in the tracker, and what is set up already — call it when the person has just started or asks what else the tracker can do. Each step has 'id', 'scope' ('company' or 'project'), 'done', 'why' (one sentence) and 'how': the next move, either an MCP 'tool' with example 'args' to call, or a 'url' of the screen to open when the step needs a token, a key or a browser — never ask for such a secret in the chat. Steps not yet done come first. Only steps the caller may take are listed: the ones that need the project's lead or the company's owner or an admin are counted in 'hidden', with a 'note' to ask them. Without 'project', the only project the caller can see is used; with several, 'projects' lists them and only the company's steps are answered.

project.description: The project's key, e.g. 'PM'. Optional when the caller can see only one project.
